source.name: Manchester United – 'SumUp becomes United's Official Sleeve Partner'
source.quote: The new agreement, which begins with Thursday's return to the UEFA Champions League, will see the SumUp logo feature on the sleeve of the playing shirt for the men’s, women’s and Academy teams across all competitions.

note: Multi-year sleeve deal announced 8 September 2026, beginning with the Champions League return; covers men's, women's and Academy teams. No value disclosed in the club announcement.
